# Keep keyboard focus stable after deleting an opportunity

## What & Why
Deleting an opportunity removes its action controls from the queue. A focused delete action can leave keyboard users at an unpredictable location, especially when the undo notice appears or the queue becomes empty.

## Done looks like
- Delete an opportunity from the queue with keyboard interaction
- Focus moves to a deterministic, accessible undo or queue control
- Browser coverage verifies both a populated queue and an empty result
